def workflow():
    # Create a Jira issue
    jira_issue_id = Jira_Issue__2_0_0__create_Issue(
        project_key="TEST",
        summary="Test issue from Python",
        description="This is a test issue created from Python.",
    )
    print(f"Created Jira issue: {jira_issue_id}")

    # Create a GitHub comment on the Jira issue's linked PR
    github_comment = GitHub_Comment__3_0_0__create_Comment(
        owner="octocat",
        repo="Hello-World",
        issue_number=1,
        body="This is a test comment from Python.",
    )
    print(f"Created GitHub comment: {github_comment['id']}")

    # Create a GitHub pull request with the Jira issue as a reference
    github_pullrequest_id = GitHub_Pullrequest__3_0_0__create_Pullrequest(
        owner="octocat",
        repo="Hello-World",
        title="Test pull request from Python",
        body="This is a test pull request created from Python.",
        issue_number=1,
    )
    print(f"Created GitHub pull request: {github_pullrequest_id}")

    # Close the Jira issue
    Jira_Issue__2_0_0__update_Issue(
        issue_id=jira_issue_id,
        fields={
            "status": {
                "name": "Closed",
            },
        },
    )
    print(f"Closed Jira issue: {jira_issue_id}")
